title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's verified Israeli sports headlines — hoops history, a European away day, and a 58-year-old Olympic mystery.

questions.question: Which NBA team did Omri Casspi make his historic debut against on 28 October 2009, becoming the first Israeli-born player in the league?
questions.explanation: Casspi debuted for the Sacramento Kings against the Thunder at the Ford Center on 28 October 2009, scoring 15 points.

questions.question: Israeli international Gabi Kanikovsky came on as a late substitute as Ferencváros won a Europa League play-off first leg away to which club?
questions.explanation: Ferencváros won 1-0 at Trabzonspor's Papara Park on 20 August 2026, with Kanikovsky entering in the 61st minute.

questions.question: How was Israel's 1968 Olympic football quarter-final against Bulgaria decided after it finished 1-1 through extra time?
answers: A drawing of lots from a hat
questions.explanation: With no shoot-out rule yet in world football, captains Mordechai Spiegler and Bulgaria's captain each drew a slip from a hat, and Israel's was the losing one.

questions.question: 18-year-old Karem Ashkenazi has returned on a long-term contract to which club, having first signed with them in 2023?
questions.explanation: Ashkenazi, from Kibbutz Beit Hillel, originally signed with Galil Elyon in 2023 and has now rejoined after a season with Maccabi Tel Aviv's youth academy.

questions.question: What was the result of the Atalanta v Hapoel Tel Aviv Conference League play-off first leg in Bergamo on 20 August 2026, after which Sarri admitted the Israelis had the physical edge?
questions.explanation: Atalanta and Hapoel Tel Aviv drew 0-0, with Sarri saying Hapoel Tel Aviv had the better of his side physically and Atalanta were overthinking on the ball.
